observed_pain: Independent NEMT operators repeatedly ask how to prove on-time performance to brokers; missed-pickup disputes cost them contracts.
core_thesis: Small NEMT fleets lose broker contracts because they cannot produce verifiable on-time-performance evidence.
evidence: 14 replies in 30 days asking how to dispute broker no-show penalties
2 operators shared spreadsheets they hand-build to contest chargebacks
broker forum thread: 'send GPS proof or eat the penalty' (87 comments)
possible_offer: verifiable trip-evidence log that exports broker-ready dispute packets
smallest_validation_action: Offer 5 engaged operators a hand-built dispute packet for one contested trip and ask for $25 if it is accepted by the broker
